The Lonely Necromancer

An old necromancer is responsible for the unrest in Kanian territory. His powerful spell prevents the dead from resting in their graves.

Objectives

Reach Death Island

Go to the necromancer's house

Set fire to the manor

Escort the necromancer

Locations

Maps
Island of Death

Authored rewards

PropertyValue

Gold160000.0
